caveats: Remote JavaScript was inspected as text and not executed; the unrelated external destination was not visited.
Station search returned JSON; the city weather data request returned HTTP 403.
Weather features were observed in application code; current weather payload completeness and correctness were not verified.
Suspicious page code does not establish its origin or compromise of other IMD services.

methods.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'weathergpt_data').is_dir() and root!=root.parent:root=root.parent
p=root/'research/discovery/evidence/citywx-20260912'
search=json.loads((p/'search-ahmedabad.json').read_text())
html=(p/'index.html').read_text()
post=json.loads((p/'ahmedabad-city-fetch.json').read_text())
summary={'station_candidates':len(search['data']),'ahmedabad_station_id':next(r['station_id'] for r in search['data'] if r['station']=='Ahmedabad'),'search_status':search['status'],'city_weather_post_http_status':post['http_status'],'android_external_window_script_present':all(s in html for s in ['isAndroid','window.open','setInterval','filmm.me']),'weather_payload_obtained':False,'integration_status':'candidate_on_hold'}
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
